limitations: Simple crown graphs with at least three matched pairs. Homology module formulas require at least five matched pairs. Ordinary wedge homotopy, not equivariant homotopy or PL equivalence; unindexed equivalent literature is possible.
scientific_integrity: Explicit homotopy-pushout proof and natural integral Mayer--Vietoris character proof; independent validation has not been performed. Finite mod-two homology and signed Lefschetz checks are supplementary evidence only.
title: Closed-neighborhood homotopy and symmetry characters of crown graphs
